name: hero-section
useFor: Use once at the top of a home or product page. `layout="split"` puts the copy beside the plate on wide screens; `center` stacks them. Pass `visual` to replace the plate (a product screen), or null for copy only. Keep the title to one sentence.
constraints: Gradients or glows behind the title
source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): HomeHero (notice tag, one-line title, short line, header-sized actions)
title: Hero section
description: The website hero: a notice chip with a solid node, the display title, one line, the Forest key and an outlined key, a mono line, and the survey plate beside or under the copy.
